summary: Iteration 10 — Verified three new features: (1) WordPress-style Add Page picker w/ layouts, (2) Shop tab + Stripe/PayPal Payment Button builder, (3) Background Music (MP3/MIDI). Backend: added TestCommerce (5 tests) covering GET /api/commerce/config, POST /api/commerce/payment-link happy path (real https://buy.stripe.com/test_ link returned), and 400 validation for empty name, zero amount, negative amount. Full pytest regression: 44/44 passed. Frontend Playwright (viewport 1920x1080, tour dismissed via localStorage webdojo.tour.done=1): AddPageModal opens, category chips work, home-modern preview iframe renders, confirm inserts blocks (canvas grew to 8 elements) and creates a NEW page tab (1→2). Industry-esports flow also creates a new tab (2→3). Blank page also creates a new tab (3→4). Shop tab: commerce-tab visible, open-payment-builder + all 3 commerce store blocks present; double-clicking cm-product-card inserts a block (canvas 0→1). Payment Builder Stripe: filled name+amount, pay-stripe-generate returned real link 'https://buy.stripe.com/test_14A6oBaV7206af8f9i9ws03', pay-insert added block (canvas 1→2). PayPal: selected provider, entered clientid 'test', pay-insert added block (2→3) and DOM contains 'paypal.com/sdk/js' + 'client-id=test'. Background music: MP3 add (3→4), MIDI add (4→5); mode-preview mounted preview-iframe successfully. Regression: Forms tab still exposes form builder elements (9 nodes matched). No console errors related to the tested features (only benign DialogContent aria-describedby warnings and a CORS error for the fake example.com/song.mid URL used in the MIDI test which is expected).

issues: Multiple DialogContent instances missing Description or aria-describedby — accessibility warnings in console. Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to each Radix DialogContent.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to AddPageModal, PaymentButtonModal, and TemplatePreviewModal DialogContent to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: buildMusicHtml for MIDI URLs: html-midi-player fetches the .mid client-side and will fail silently for cross-origin hosts without CORS — surface a small hint in the BackgroundMediaPanel UI so authors don't publish a broken widget.

PaymentLinkCreate has no upper bound / precision validation on amount — a very large float or many decimals will silently truncate at int(round(amount*100)). Consider Pydantic Decimal + max value + rejecting >2 decimals.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows passed: add-page x3, shop, stripe, paypal, music mp3+midi, preview mode, forms regression)

seed_data_creation: No persisted app data seeded. Stripe test-mode Price + PaymentLink objects were created in the claimable sandbox during payment-link tests (acceptable — test-mode only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tour is now dismissible via localStorage.setItem('webdojo.tour.done','1') before navigation — reliable and avoids the click-through. AddPageModal testids: page-add-btn, add-page-modal, add-page-cat-<Category>, add-page-item-<id>, add-page-preview-iframe, add-blank-page, add-page-confirm. Payment builder: open-payment-builder, payment-builder-modal, pay-provider-stripe/paypal, pay-name, pay-amount, pay-stripe-generate, pay-stripe-link, pay-paypal-clientid, pay-insert, payment-preview-iframe. Music: insp-tab-bg, bg-media-panel, music-type-mp3/midi, music-url, add-music-btn. Preview mode: mode-preview / mode-design and preview-iframe.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects blocking the feature set.
